info.name: ParaBank API Testing
info.description: Postman API tests covering account creation, account lookup, and customer account listing (positive and negative scenarios).

request.description: US-01 — Create a checking account using an existing customer and source account. Creates data on every run.
US-02 — Retrieve a known account by ID.
US-02 — Negative case: request a nonexistent account.
US-03 — Retrieve accounts for a customer.
US-03 — Negative case: request accounts for a nonexistent customer.
